title: Ruth Paine and Marina find the Walker note after the FBI search

tellings.quote: the assassination, after the FBI's already searched the home extensively, Ruth Payne comes and says, "Oh, me and Marina found this other uh note that he left for Marina.

plain: After President Kennedy was killed in 1963, and after the FBI had already searched the house thoroughly, Ruth Paine, the woman whose Texas home Marina Oswald was living in, is said to have come forward with another note Lee Harvey Oswald had left for his wife Marina. This was the note linked to an attempt on Edwin Walker, a retired Army general. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this on the show, quoting Paine as saying, "Oh, me and Marina found this other note," and he raises it to suggest that the late discovery of the note, missed by the FBI's search, casts doubt on Paine's role.
